small_guidance: The conv kernel uses 255 registers/thread limiting occupancy to 16%. Reduce register pressure: drop allow_tf32=False (use TF32) to shrink the inner dot, shrink BLOCK_OC/BLOCK_SP tiles in autotune (try (32,32), (16,64)) and add num_warps=2 configs. Also avoid recomputing id_/ih_/iw_ index math per kw — hoist kd/kh-only terms outside inner loops and precompute spatial valid masks once.
large_guidance: Restructure conv_transpose3d as a gather/im2col GEMM: one program per (N, OC-tile, output-spatial-tile) with explicit BLOCK_M×BLOCK_K and BLOCK_K×BLOCK_N operand tiles where K = IC*KD*KH*KW, using tl.dot with TF32. Loop over K in chunks (BLOCK_K=16 or 32), computing per-(kd,kh,kw,ic) input gather with stride/pad masking; this exposes more ILP and reuses weights across the OC tile. Use channels_last input layout so IC is contiguous along K. Fuse the BN scale/shift and per-(N,C) spatial-mean subtraction into the conv epilogue by writing to output only after a second pass — or at minimum fuse BN affine into the conv store, eliminating the separate apply_scale_submean pass.
